title: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 financial results for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and slide presentation (Exhibit 99.2), with an investor webcast scheduled for April 23, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET. The company is a Georgia-chartered bank holding company (PNFP) with common stock and three preferred series listed on the NYSE.
key_points: Pinnacle Financial Partners is a Georgia-chartered bank holding company trading as PNFP on the NYSE.
The filing discloses Q1 2026 financial results for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026.
The company has four securities listed: common stock (PNFP), Series A Preferred (PNFP-PrA), Series B Preferred (PNFP-PrB), and Series C Depositary Shares (PNFP-PrC).
An investor webcast is scheduled for April 23, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET.
This is a standard SEC current report pursuant to Sections 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
